title: screens
body:
you could sit for hours entertained in solitude
as your eyes grow strained.
artificial photons pumping dopamine so
effortlessly the slow rotation of the earth
leaves no impression on your fixated spirit.
why face the world when
you can spend eternity in
your own numbing sanctuary?

so you jam your headphones into your ears
so you never get the chance to hear the
birds chirping and the leaves crushing
beneath your feet.
and you stare into your tiny metal portal
so you don't have to face the fact that there
isn't always something there to acknowledge you.
you immerse yourself so deeply in your led
fiction that you deprive yourself of the zen
from the white noise and the quiet
hellos from the strangers you pass by.

and so you miss the mundane breaths you
so needed.
